text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Gold City talking to
Ines Fujin. It seemed she was asking for advice, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, mornings are seriously my weakness.
Even if I manage to wake up, my brain just won't work on set...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ines-senpai, you wake up super early, right?
I heard about it from Helios-san and Palmer-san.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, you think so?
I woke up at 5:00 AM today and delivered newspapers!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Waking up at 5:00 AM?! Oh, crap...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, you're on a whole different level... Could you maybe
teach me your secret or share some tips?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A trick, huh... Hmmmmmm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I guess it's about relaxing before bed and getting a good night's rest. City-chan, do you fall asleep easily?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all...
Whenever I try to sleep, all sorts of thoughts pop into my head. Yesterday too—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I took off my makeup, took a shower, and went to bed early
to get ready for morning practice, but—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I just suddenly remembered our meeting from earlier today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And then I start kicking myself, thinking, 'I should've said that,' and from there, I start wondering what to do for the next shoot—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And then, I kinda just passed out, so
waking up today was seriously exhausting...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"When you're feeling troubled over work or something,
that's usually how it feels."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see, I see... In that case,
you can't get a good night's sleep, and waking up must be tough, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, why don't you make
a bedtime routine? That should stop your head from spinning!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So you mean switching your mindset
through a routine?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, something relaxing might be nice.
For example, in my case—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Every night, you know, I make a point
to look at my family photos in my phone's album.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When I look at my family's faces, it brings back memories.
Like having dinner together,
or watching TV with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"When you do that, you'll gradually
start to feel more at ease."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"It's super relaxing,
and helps you sleep like a log!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I see, so that's Ines-senpai's routine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! So you should try doing things that calm your mind too, City-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see, that might actually be good.
I'll think a bit about a routine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, I bumped into Ines Fujin on my way
to the academy. As we headed toward the school building together—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ines-senpai, good morning.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
City-chan, good morning!
You look like you're in great shape today♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Actually, I've been waking up
feeling totally refreshed lately.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ever since senpai gave me advice on a routine,
I've been trying to come up with one of my own.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ever since I started burning herbal aroma oils before bed, I've been falling asleep much faster.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Your routine really worked, huh!
I'm so glad it went well!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm seriously grateful. Well...
not that it stops me from oversleeping a lot, though.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, this is only the beginning! Keep it up,
and you'll be able to wake up much easier!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's true. Thank you very much.
Well, I have morning self-practice, so see you later!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad my advice
seemed to help!
choice_data_list: Give me some advice too, please!
Please give me some advice too!
Aines really is everyone's big sister, huh.
Aines really is everyone's big sister, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad my advice
seemed to help!
choice_data_list: Give me some advice too, please!
Please give me some advice too!
Aines really is everyone's big sister, huh.
Aines really is everyone's big sister, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! I've got sooooo much
I wanna say to you, after all~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
First off, working without taking breaks just because you're busy is a no-go!
Drinking only coffee and no water is also completely off-limits!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Your posture when using the computer is bad too.
Sit up straighter, and back away from the screen.
And another thing—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no take-backs! But don't worry.
Big sis Ines will coach you through eve~rything♪
Now then, about mealtime—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With her big-sister instincts fired up, Ines Fujin simply couldn't be stopped.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, aren't you exaggerating a bit?
Still, I'm happy you're relying on me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Trainer, don't move!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There's lint on your jacket.
Hold still, let me get that for you!
choice_data_list: Ah, no, I can get it myself...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looking closely, your sleeve button is about to fall off too!
I have a sewing kit, so I'll sew it back on for you later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Ines Fujin naturally finds herself looking after others. That's probably why everyone always wants to turn to her for advice."
